<h1>TR-8 Velocity Arp</h1>

## Purpose

Same model as the synth velocity arp, targeting the TR-8's per-voice
velocity arp arrays. **Alt-kit aware**: writes go to the main
(`tr8_velo_arp_*`) or alt (`tr8_velo_arp_*_alt`) arrays depending on the
TR-8 alt latch state.

## Interaction

Two-stage editor. **LHS LP**: overview of all 8 rows' arp patterns and the
row/length selector. **RHS LP**: value editor for the selected row (column =
arp step 1–8, row = value 0–7). Each RHS column shows one lit pad at the
stored value's height, not a filled bar. If a drum-cycle event arrives while
this view is open, the view stays visible (so the editor can follow the new
alt state) even though the sequencer selection snaps.

## Shortcuts

### LHS: overview side

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row R, col N | LP LHS | Select row R; a double-tap within 350 ms sets its length to N slots | none |
| SHIFT + press row R, col N | LP LHS | Select row R and set its length to N slots immediately | shift |
| Press row R, col 9 | LP LHS col 9 | Select row R without changing its length | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R, col 9 | LP LHS col 9 | **Reset** the pressed row's voice to its canonical value: ghost rows 2, boom-tsk 7, all others 5 (alt-view-aware) | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press col 9 | LP LHS col 9 | **Randomise** the selected arp freely across values 0–7 | shift+solo |

### RHS: value editor

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | LP RHS | Write the pressed row's value into the selected row's arp step (column 1–8) | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R | LP RHS | **Reset**: fill selected arp with row R's value (alt-view-aware) | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press row R | LP RHS | **Randomise**: selected arp gaussian around row R | shift+solo |

A stored length of 0 means one active slot, not disabled playback. Column 1
therefore parks the voice on its first velocity value. There is no off state
for the TR-8 velocity arp.
